key_insight: Injecting a curated ECG interpretation guide into a multimodal LLM makes ECG report generation more guideline-grounded and less hallucinatory.
clinical_relevance: This could improve the trustworthiness and reproducibility of AI-generated ECG explanations for cardiac assessment.
method: CNN analyzes 12-lead ECG images and outputs class probabilities.
Grad-CAM creates class-specific heatmaps and a fact pack from the ECG.
A multimodal LLM generates structured reports using the ECG image, heatmap, CNN facts, and a fixed offline ECG guide.
evidence_signal: On the full PTB-XL test set, the method raised impression BERTScore from 0.818 to 0.953 versus a strong baseline while keeping competitive classification performance.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on the quality and completeness of the curated guide, so mismatches with local practice or unusual ECG patterns could still affect reliability.
paper_title: Enhancing Explainable Cardiac Diagnosis with Guide-Grounded Multimodal LLMs
